items.reason: Gap 0 explicitly describes concurrent same-event deliveries both passing the check before either adds the ID and processing twice.
Gap 1 states that deduplication uses the unsigned X-Event-Id header and explains how changing it on a signed body bypasses deduplication.
Gap 2 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the handler is registered as refund.created, preventing refund processing.
No gap alleges a failure that depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
